title: Beyond empathy: Cognitive capabilities increase or curb altruism in middle childhood
authors: Rose, L., Kovarski, K., Caetta, F., Makowski, D., & Chokron, S.
summary: Altruism in children is usually explained by empathy. This study asks what cognitive capacities add on top of it in middle childhood, and finds them cutting both ways — increasing generosity in some conditions and curbing it in others.
